title: Essentials of Internal Audit
overview: Internal auditing, as defined by the Institute of Internal Auditors, is an independent and objective assurance and consulting activity aimed at adding value and improving an organization’s operations. By applying a systematic and disciplined approach, it enhances the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes to support organizational goals.

In light of evolving regulatory demands and corporate governance standards, stakeholders now place heightened expectations on internal audit functions. This course equips participants with the essential knowledge, tools, and techniques to conduct internal audits effectively, aligning them with organizational strategies and enhancing sustainability
audience: This course is designed for individuals with some auditing experience, junior auditors, finance professionals, and other department staff who wish to develop a best-practice approach to internal auditing. It is also ideal for supervisors and managers seeking to refresh and enhance their knowledge in this area.
methodology: This course employs an engaging blend of methods, including expert-led presentations, real-world case studies, live demonstrations of sampling techniques, and group exercises, ensuring the practical application of key concepts.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define the scope and function of internal auditing within an organization.
Understand the standards that form the framework for internal auditing activities.
Differentiate between various types of internal audit assignments, such as operational, compliance, and financial audits.
Apply techniques for risk identification, control evaluation, and controls testing.
Select appropriate internal audit testing tools and evaluate their pros and cons.
Utilize best practices for sampling in internal audit assignments, including sample size and selection.
Recognize fraud indicators and understand the auditor’s responsibilities when fraud is detected.
